title.narrative: Strengthening the Amazon Initiative Consortium (AI) to address the need for sustainable resource use systems in the Amazon

description.narrative: The developmental objective (DO) is to strengthen the capacity of the Amazon Initiative Consortium (AI) to develop mechanisms and tools for sharing knowledge on institutional innovations that promote sustainable resource use and management among the Amazon basin-based research and development institutions. Achieving the DO would lead to: (a) enhancing local competence to implement strategies that minimize the impact of conversion of forest to other land uses; (b) strengthening existing national institutional capabilities related to agriculture, forestry, and agro-forestry while integrating the work of the research and academic institutions and target producer groups; and (c) improving the design, implementation, and mainstreaming of regional programs aimed at sustainable use of natural resources in the Amazon basin. Project is designed with two technical components and one administrative component: (a) Capacity building and the sharing of data and knowledge for collaborative research in the Amazon Basin and (b) Amazon livelihoods baseline approach and (c) Audits of the project. tool kits for sharing knowledge on institutional innovations that promote sustainable resource use and management among the Amazon Achieving the DO would lead to: (a) enhancing local competence to implement strategies that minimize the impact of conversion of forest to other land uses; (b) strengthening existing national institutional capabilities related to agriculture, forestry, and agro-forestry while integrating the work of the research and academic institutions and target producer groups; and (c) improving the design, implementation, and mainstreaming of regional programs aimed at sustainable use of natural resources in the Amazon basin.
